description: This source file defines SwiftUI views and associated components for a macOS app that render and manage a transcript text view and a vibrant label. It includes `TranscriptTextView`, a wrapper around an `NSTextView` for editing transcripts with delegate handling, and `VibrantLabelView`, a label with tap interaction capabilities. Additional internal classes manage the `NSTextView` behavior and user interactions.

classes.name: TranscriptNSTextView
classes.description: A subclass of NSTextView that handles specific key events such as sending messages, escaping, and managing focus events.

classes.name: ClickCatcher
classes.description: A NSView subclass that detects mouse clicks to trigger an onTap callback, used for making the label tappable.

methods.name: makeCoordinator
methods.description: Creates a Coordinator instance to manage NSTextView delegate callbacks.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Constructs and configures an NSScrollView containing a custom NSTextView.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the view with new attributed text, managing programmatic updates and focus state.

methods.name: textDidBeginEditing
methods.description: Delegate callback invoked when text editing begins.

methods.name: textDidEndEditing
methods.description: Delegate callback invoked when text editing ends.

methods.name: textDidChange
methods.description: Delegate callback invoked when the text content changes.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates the NSView for the vibrant label, configuring tap gesture recognition.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the label's attributed string and appearance when the view is refreshed.

methods.name: mouseDown
methods.description: Overrides mouseDown to detect clicks and trigger the onTap callback.

methods.name: keyDown
methods.description: Handles special key presses like Return, Shift+Return, Escape, and Command+Return for appropriate actions.
